name_to_email = {}
for trip, members in group_members.items():
    mapping = {}
    for m in members:
        mapping[m['name']] = m['email']
    name_to_email[trip] = mapping

# Define all expenses as (group_key, description, amount, payer_name, participants_names)

    # Santorini
    ("santorini", "Boat Tour", 100, "Timothy White", ["Timothy White", "Debra Ritter"]),
    ("santorini", "Adventure Gear", 200, "Claudia Miller", ["Claudia Miller", "Debra Ritter"]),
    # Venice
    ("venice", "Night Out", 200, "Kristin White", ["Jeremy Calhoun", "Kristin White"]),
    ("venice", "Snorkeling Gear", 80, "Jeremy Calhoun", ["Jeremy Calhoun", "Kristin White"]),
    ("venice", "Cruise Tickets", 600, "Matthew Blackburn", ["Jeremy Calhoun", "Matthew Blackburn", "Kristin White"]),
    # Tokyo
    ("tokyo", "Airbnb", 250, "Timothy White", ["Timothy White", "Michael Burch", "Norman Smith", "Brandon Weber"]),
    ("tokyo", "Train Tickets", 150, "Brandon Weber", ["Kevin Blackburn", "Michael Burch", "Norman Smith", "Brandon Weber", "Timothy White"]),
    ("tokyo", "Cabin Rental", 400, "Kevin Blackburn", ["Norman Smith", "Brandon Weber", "Timothy White", "Kevin Blackburn", "Michael Burch"]),

# Record each expense
